name: Poulan ES300 / ES350
blurb: Oregon prints one chain for ES300 and ES350: 16″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .043″ gauge, 56 drive links (R56).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Poulan ES300 and ES350 on one line with chain R56: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. R56 is the .043″ low-profile loop. An S56 is .050″ and does not belong in this groove. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints R56 under Poulan ES300 and ES350: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
